fullCourseName: Python Programming for Mobile Robotics @ Metropolia
shortCourseName: Python Programming for Mobile Robotics @ Metropolia
shortDescription: Learn Python with the Metropolia research rover: movement, sensors and adaptive line following in a Jezero-inspired robot laboratory.
fullDescription: Program a real mobile robot in a remote laboratory inspired by exploration of Jezero crater on Mars. Learn Python through movement, functions, loops, lists and line sensors, then build a line follower with proportional steering and adaptive speed. Open activities from Moodle for automatic LTI sign-in; no separate Ondroid registration is needed.
requirements: No previous programming or robotics knowledge is required.
